test_period_note: Full calendar year 2018 (2018-01-01 to 2018-12-31) test split for the official, unseen test household (8386) only (data/processed/window_labels_test.parquet). The four development households (7901, 7951, 8565, 3538) have zero rows in this split -- they were never held out from training/validation, so pooled test metrics are computed exclusively on the unseen household.

ccp_benchmarks.note: Classification benchmarks only; the CCP specifies no MAE/RMSE threshold.
